subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu plugin send message fails with 400 error - receive_id_type is required

question: Is source evidence around Feishu target classification enough to adopt or replace the linked fork PR now, or should maintainers require current-main Feishu live proof with vendor diagnostics first?
rationale: The source path is suspicious but not conclusive because current main passes `receive_id_type`, the reporter's manual API call also failed, and the only open linked PR is conflicting and unproven.

options.title: Require current Feishu proof
options.body: Ask for a latest-release or current-main Feishu send failure with redacted vendor code/log_id before reviving or replacing the linked PR.

options.title: Adopt the linked fork PR
options.body: Accept the nullable target-resolution direction, update the conflicting branch or replacement branch, and require type fixes, regression tests, and real Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Close after external proof
options.body: If fresh diagnostics show a Feishu app availability, permission, or tenant-policy problem rather than OpenClaw target construction, close this issue with the external setup evidence.

recommendation.title: Require current Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a latest-release or current-main Feishu send failure with redacted vendor code/log_id before reviving or replacing the linked PR.
